The '''Xxan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xxan]].
